exposure: mode of delivery (Caesarean section before labor vs. induction of labor)
cohort: Women with an indicated preterm birth between 22 and 37 weeks of gestation, for whom vaginal delivery was possible, at a regional university hospital over a 22-month period.
finding: Indicated preterm birth accounted for almost half of preterm births and one-third of these were delivered via Caesarean section before labor, with the Caesarean section group having lower birth weight, lower Apgar scores, and higher newborn hospitalization rates.
